stemMd: A jar contains 3 green and 2 yellow beads. Two are drawn without replacement. What is the probability they have different colours?
explanationMd: Different colours occur in two orders: (3/5)(2/4)+(2/5)(3/4)=6/20+6/20=12/20=3/5. Without replacement, the denominator on the second draw is four.

distractorRationale.b: This counts only green-then-yellow and omits the reverse order.
distractorRationale.c: This is the probability of the same colour, the complement.
distractorRationale.a: This treats the draws as independent and counts one order only.
distractorRationale.d: The possible colour outcomes are not all equally likely.
